atoms.text: Bea made a cake for her sisters birthday. She reached into the cupboard for sugar, but she picked up the salt instead and poured it into the bowl. At the party, she serves everyone a slice of cake.

atoms.a: Based on what you have read, how do you think people will react to the taste of the cake?

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the question.

atoms.text: Bea goes to the kitchen to get some strawberries to try and make the cake edible. For this to work, the strawberries will have to be sweet and juicy. Unfortunately, all the strawberries they have are quite sharp and sour.

atoms.a: Based on what you have read, will the strawberries fix the taste of the cake?

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the question.

atoms.text: Everyone starts to put their slices of cake into the food waste bin. They try to do so without Bea noticing, so that she does not get upset. As she is clearing up, Bea takes a carrot stick to the food bin.

atoms.a: Based on what you have read, what is the most likely outcome?
